summary: Analyzed CI run 27551734921: 70 active warnings across 10 files (incremental build). Clean build would reveal ~250-350 warnings across ~50 files. Seven warning categories identified: push_neg deprecation (138 occurrences, 22 files), unscoped linter.flexible (24 files), unscoped maxHeartbeats (16 occurrences, 12 files), module docstring placement (13 files), unused simp args (18 in 3 files), flexible simp (18 in 2 files), unused hypotheses (4 in 3 files). All fixes are mechanical. Recommended 5-phase implementation: (1) push_neg global rename, (2) docstring reordering, (3) unused arg/hypothesis removal, (4) option scoping, (5) flexible simp suppression. Parallelizable by subdirectory.
